method.rgb_histograms: sRGB encoded values, normalized by pixel count
method.Y_histogram: Rounded gamma-encoded Y'=0.2126R+0.7152G+0.0722B; not linear luminance
method.histogram_overlap: sum(min(p,q))*100; bin-sensitive, not percent identical colors
method.bhattacharyya: sum(sqrt(p*q))*100; distribution affinity, not accuracy or percent identical pixels
method.Lab: sRGB IEC transfer function -> XYZ D65 -> CIE Lab D65; no embedded ICC found expected
method.delta_E00: CIEDE2000 kL=kC=kH=1; checked against 4 published Sharma reference pairs
method.colored_subject_mask: Inside subject rectangle; camera Lab chroma >15 and 5<L*<95; same mask on both members of pair
limitations: One scene per look, not all scenes or video.
Metadata is evidence of saved tags, not a complete Edit adjustment history.
Different JPEG quantization, demosaic, denoise and sharpening can cause residual differences.
Downsampled DeltaE suppresses fine detail differences; full-resolution RGB errors reported separately.
Histogram similarity ignores positions; paired spatial metrics are included.

cross_look_context.limitation: Different exposures/times; no geometric registration, not an isolated look effect.
